## Fundamental Series — Part 13 of 20

Manipulasi data dimulai dari dua operasi paling dasar: **memilih baris** (filter) dan **memilih kolom** (select).

---

## Setup Data

```python
import pandas as pd
import polars as pl

data = {
    "nama":   ["Andi", "Budi", "Citra", "Dina", "Eko"],
    "kota":   ["Jakarta", "Bandung", "Jakarta", "Surabaya", "Bandung"],
    "umur":   [25, 30, 28, 35, 22],
    "gaji":   [5000, 7000, 6000, 8000, 4500],
    "status": ["aktif", "aktif", "nonaktif", "aktif", "nonaktif"]
}

df_pd = pd.DataFrame(data)
df_pl = pl.DataFrame(data)
```

---

## Filter Baris — Pandas

```python
# Boolean indexing
df_pd[df_pd["kota"] == "Jakarta"]

# Multiple kondisi (AND — gunakan &)
df_pd[(df_pd["kota"] == "Jakarta") & (df_pd["umur"] > 25)]

# OR — gunakan |
df_pd[(df_pd["kota"] == "Jakarta") | (df_pd["kota"] == "Bandung")]

# isin
df_pd[df_pd["kota"].isin(["Jakarta", "Bandung"])]

# query() — lebih readable
df_pd.query("kota == 'Jakarta' and umur > 25")
df_pd.query("kota in ['Jakarta', 'Bandung']")
```

---

## Filter Baris — Polars

```python
# filter
df_pl.filter(pl.col("kota") == "Jakarta")

# Multiple kondisi
df_pl.filter(
    (pl.col("kota") == "Jakarta") & (pl.col("umur") > 25)
)

# OR
df_pl.filter(
    pl.col("kota").is_in(["Jakarta", "Bandung"])
)

# Negasi
df_pl.filter(~pl.col("kota").is_in(["Surabaya"]))
```

---

## Select Kolom — Pandas

```python
# Satu kolom (Series)
df_pd["nama"]

# Multiple kolom (DataFrame)
df_pd[["nama", "gaji"]]

# loc — by label
df_pd.loc[:, "nama":"umur"]

# iloc — by position
df_pd.iloc[:, 0:3]
df_pd.iloc[:3]        # 3 baris pertama

# Filter kolom numerik
df_pd.select_dtypes(include="number")
```

---

## Select Kolom — Polars

```python
df_pl.select("nama", "gaji")
df_pl.select(pl.col("nama", "gaji"))

# Semua kolom numerik
df_pl.select(pl.col(pl.Int64, pl.Float64))

# Exclude kolom
df_pl.select(pl.all().exclude("status"))
```

---

## Rename Kolom

```python
# Pandas
df_pd.rename(columns={"gaji": "salary", "kota": "city"})

# Polars
df_pl.rename({"gaji": "salary", "kota": "city"})
```

---

## Kombinasi Filter + Select

```python
# Pandas
(df_pd
    .query("status == 'aktif' and gaji > 5000")
    [["nama", "kota", "gaji"]]
)

# Polars
(df_pl
    .filter((pl.col("status") == "aktif") & (pl.col("gaji") > 5000))
    .select("nama", "kota", "gaji")
)
```

---

## Ringkasan

| Operasi | Pandas | Polars |
|---------|--------|--------|
| Filter baris | `df[mask]` / `.query()` | `.filter()` |
| Select kolom | `df[["col"]]` / `.loc` | `.select()` |
| isin/is_in | `.isin([])` | `pl.col().is_in([])` |
| Rename | `.rename(columns={})` | `.rename({})` |
| Kolom numerik | `.select_dtypes()` | `pl.col(pl.Int64)` |
